subject: Onboarding & temporary PO waiver request — KiteWorks pilot
messages:
From: Samir Patel <samir@kiteworks.com>
To: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.ai>
Cc: procureops@kiteworks.com
Date: Mon, 1 Jun 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request: onboarding & PO waiver for pilot

Hi Rachel,

Thanks for the demo last week — the team is excited to get a short pilot standing up.

We'd like to start a 30-day trial next week and need vendor access to your hosted API.
Two asks to accelerate intake on our side:
- Can Redwood onboard KiteWorks without a formal PO for the initial 30-day pilot? We estimate ~$4k for the pilot period.
- Attached is the SOW for the trial and a brief security questionnaire.

If a PO is required we can route quickly, but our procurement team (cc'd) prefers an invoice-first path for pilots. Let me know what information you need from our side.

Thanks,
Samir Patel
Head of Partnerships, KiteWorks
Samir Patel <samir@kiteworks.com>

Attachment: KiteWorks_Pilot_SOW_v1.pdf (pdf)
Attachment: KiteWorks_Security_Questionnaire.xlsx (xlsx)

From: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.ai>
To: Samir Patel <samir@kiteworks.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 1 Jun 2026 10:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: onboarding & PO waiver for pilot

Hi Samir — great to hear.

We can move quickly on the pilot. Quick summary of next steps from our side:
1) I'll loop in Procurement and Finance to confirm whether a temporary PO waiver is acceptable for a 30-day trial.
2) Marissa (cc) will prepare a short mutual action plan and confirm the estimated spend.
3) Please complete the security questionnaire you attached; our security team will review and may ask for one follow-up item.

If Procurement needs additional assurances, we can sign the DPA + an SSO requirement to keep the pilot scoped and low risk. Are you able to accept SSO and DPA for the trial?

Marissa will also propose an invoice cadence (single invoice at trial end or monthly).

Thanks — I will escalate to Procurement/Finance and come back with an approval matrix by EOD.

Best,
Rachel Kim
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.ai>

From: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.ai>
To: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 1 Jun 2026 14:20:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: onboarding & PO waiver for pilot

Rachel / Marissa —

Thanks for the heads up, Rachel. Short answer: our standard vendor onboarding requires a Purchase Order for any production invoicing. That said, we do have a limited temporary exception process for low-risk pilot engagements. Before I can approve an exception I need the following: 

1) Formal business justification (concise) explaining why a PO will materially delay the pilot (one paragraph is fine).
2) Confirmation that KiteWorks will sign Redwood's DPA and will use SSO for any admin console access.
3) Completed security questionnaire and any supporting artifacts (pen test summary, SOC report if available).
4) A capped spend threshold for the pilot (we typically limit to $10k/month for PO-waivers).

If all items are satisfied, Procurement can approve a time-boxed PO-waiver for up to 90 days under an internal PO-WAIVER ID. Conditions: invoices must be tagged with the PO-WAIVER ID and routed to Finance (laura.bennett@redwood.ai) for tracking.

Please reply with the evidence requested so we can move this to an exception review.

— Markus Klein
Director, Procurement Operations
Redwood Inference

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.ai>, Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.ai>, Samir Patel <samir@kiteworks.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 2 Jun 2026 08:30:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: onboarding & PO waiver for pilot

Markus — thanks for outlining the checklist. Quick responses from KiteWorks / Sales side so Procurement can triage fast: 

- Business justification: this is a technical validation tied to an active POC with a potential $120k ARR expansion if successful; delaying by routing a PO will push schedule and jeopardize the calendar-based integration slot.
- DPA & SSO: KiteWorks confirmed they will sign Redwood's DPA and support SSO provisioning.
- Security artifacts: Samir has attached the questionnaire and indicated a recent third-party pen test summary is available on request.
- Spend cap: pilot estimate is $4k total for 30 days. We request the PO-waiver for up to $5k to provide a small buffer.

Ask: can Procurement approve a 30-day PO-waiver (not the full 90 days) conditional on DPA + SSO + invoices carrying the PO-WAIVER ID? If yes, Sales will finalize the mutual action plan and send a single invoice at pilot completion.

Samir — I will send the MAP and the billing routing details after we have procurement's quick sign-off. Markus, can you approve this conditional exception by EOD today? If you need the pen test summary I can get it within the hour.

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
Senior Sales Manager, Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.ai

Date: Tue, 2 Jun 2026 16:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: onboarding & PO waiver for pilot

Team / Samir —

Finance can approve a time-limited PO-waiver for the 30-day pilot under the following controls: 

- Waiver period: 30 days (2026-06-07 through 2026-07-06)
- Spend cap: $5,000 total
- Invoice routing: KiteWorks to send a single invoice at pilot completion to laura.bennett@redwood.ai and billing@redwood.ai (cc'd). Invoice must reference PO-WAIVER ID: PW-2026-0602-KW.
- GL/Cost center: charge to Cost Center 4500; submit Cost Center and Project code on the invoice.
- Evidence: DPA executed and completed security questionnaire required before any production credentials are issued.

I've attached the internal waiver approval PDF for records. This approval is conditional and will be rescinded if the security review flags material issues or if invoices exceed the cap.

Samir — please confirm you accept these terms and confirm who will sign the DPA. Once you confirm, Procurement / Sales will provision a sandbox API key and we'll kick off the MAP.

Regards,
Laura Bennett
Finance Manager, Redwood Inference
laura.bennett@redwood.ai

Attachment: PO_Waiver_Approval_20260602.pdf (pdf)
